prompt: chat template, no system message, user = segment + blank line + SPEC; R = last token

decoding.note: Qwen3 generation_config defaults (0.6/20/0.95) overridden and asserted

hf.seed_rule: torch.manual_seed(stable_hash(task, paraphrase_id)) for every arm (common random numbers)

direction.selection: 5-fold CV held-out AUC (mean over tasks), ties within 0.005 broken by d'
direction.injection: x <- x + c * ||x|| * d_hat at R (prefill) and every generated position, on layers[L-1] output

c_star_rule: largest c with pass >= 0.8 x pass(HF c=0), pass rate only

hf: dc c in {0,0.25,0.5,1,1.5} + bisection, N=100 each
cross-task dc transfer at c*, N=50 (E4)

labeller: hidden tests + runtime tracer (3 probes) + AST rules; disagreements -> gemini-2.5-flash-lite judge; gate with gpt-4.1-mini + claude-haiku-4.5 resolver
